Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:237522
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 51760 of 2023

Applicant :- Aayan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Ganesh Shanker Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State, apprised the Court that notice has been served to the informant of the case on 30.11.2023.
2. Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.
3. Heard Sri Ganesh Shankar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan,
learned AGA, for the State.

4. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.0280 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Siddharth Nagar, District Siddharth Nagar during pendency of the trial.

entities.text: Police Station Siddharth Nagar, District Siddharth Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
5. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his parents and according to the FIR,
applicant enticed away the sister of the informant aged about 17 years with the help of his parents under the pretext to perform marriage with her.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and actually victim, who is major girl, herself had gone along with the applicant according to her own wish and this fact is evident from her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
7.

He further submits that victim and applicant both loved each other but applicants belongs to different community, therefore, parents of the victim were not ready to perform marriage of victim with the applicant and only due to this reason after recovery victim stated that under the false promise of marriage applicant made physical relationship with her and thereafter left her behind the Railway Station.
8. He further submits that applicant is still ready to solemnize marriage with the victim.

9. He further submits that as per school record and the certificate issued by CMO concerned, victim is around 17 years old but she is major girl aged about 18 years and even appearance wise she looks like major girl.
10. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 25.9.2023.

11. Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayerfor bail could not dispute the fact that even as per school record and the report of CMO concerned, the age of the victim is around 17 years and from her both the statements recorded during investigation it appears that she was consenting party.

12. Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that applicant and victim both belong to different community.
13.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

14. However, victim in her both the statements recorded during investigation stated that under the false promise of marriage applicant made physical relationship with her and thereafter left her but from her both the statements, her consent is apparent.

15. Further, even in the FIR of the present case it has been mentioned that informant, i..e, brother of the victim was having suspicion that applicant, who belongs to different community, would change religion of her sister, therefore, in the light of the contents of the FIR, argument advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant that as applicant belongs to different community, therefore,
parents of the victim including the informant were against the marriage of the victim with applicant,
cannot be completely ruled out at this stage.
16.

Further, even according to the report of CMO concerned and the school record of the victim, she was around 17 years and, therefore, at this stage possibility cannot be ruled out that she may be even more than 18 years and in this regard also argument advanced by the learned counsel for the Aayan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180594502/
2

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: applicant that even appearance wise victim looks like major girl cannot be completely brushed aside at this stage.
17. Further, applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since September, 2023.

18. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
19. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

20. Let the applicant-Aayan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
21.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

22. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
